notes.title: Regular update of the full version is out now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Our top priority is to deliver a great gaming experience to our players. In this effort, we are bringing a major update with improvements and fixes based on the performance of the game among players after lunch. Many thanks for your feedback, you are helping us to perfect this game. 

Addressed issues:


Bugs:

  Knocked-out enemies rarely fell into the surrounding geometry in such an unfortunate way, that they got invisible.
  Searching issue in "Petrol Quest" from mission 02
  Units carrying a mobile-mounted gun would lose it under some rare conditions.
  Automatic healing now works differently. Before a unit had to survive an attack to apply a medkit afterwards. Now a medkit in personal inventory effectively extends the unit's health. The unit can take damage, that would be lethal otherwise.
  Silent eradication of stunned enemies is now really silent.
  Unwanted open fire after Knockout
  Infinitely looping Alarm Music
  Incorrect navigation and collisions in several missions

Improvements:

  Improved gameplay of the first mission
  Extended Inventory tutorial
  Extended Weapons description
  "Sell all tradeable items" button
  Inventory slots description
  New obtained skill notification icon
  More noticeable visual information of the alert
  Units remember crouch/stealth command after leaving a cover.
  A synchronized transition between Run and Crouch

notes.title: GrayZone full release announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are thrilled to announce that GrayZone, a story-driven tactical RTS with stealth and RPG elements,
will be leaving Early Access on Steam on December 16.

Gray Zone is the adventurous journey of a slave in the hands of a corrupt government who turned against his masters. The game features memorable characters, fun dialogues, action, and lots of voice acting.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/612a80679a2d03076cee58c74ab144edc4e9a79c.png

You can look forward to at least 15 hours of entertaining gameplay throughout 7 story missions and 2 challenging skirmish actions.

Enjoy the atmosphere of the rough wasteland of planet Deleon and join the company of rebels to strengthen their difficult position.

notes.title: GRAY ZONE MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
Embark on the great adventure of Valern, a slave in the hands of a corrupt government, and explore colonized planets as you command your heroes to complete story objectives.

Gray Zone features 2D Artwork and comics that chronicle the story’s progress between missions. The game also contains its own electro-orchestral soundtrack. 

As the development of Gray Zone progresses, mission 7 and Skirmish will be integrated into the current chapter of the game. 3 additional chapters will be released as standalone, episodic game content.

notes.title: Developers update
notes.notes:
Hello there once again! 

 As we mentioned once, we stopped updating the image with what we’re planning on doing for each month. We found it too static and it didn’t engage our community as much as we would like so we made a decision. We came up with another way of how to inform our players about what’s going on in our game development kitchen. We’re sure many of you heard about Trello, which will be, from now on, a place for you, our players, to see what’s really going on. You will find new ideas that we have, small things we’re working on and others there. As always, we love your feedback, which is why you can easily write your ideas, complaints or show us some love through Discord. 

If you want to access our Trello Roadmap click here or you want to be part of our Discord community click here.

We’re also about to show you a bit of what we’ve been working on these days. 

 New items 

Working on new items is never a bad idea. That's why we’re working on new items which the player will be able to find while looting or by searching for them in missions. They’re being implemented to each mission step by step nevertheless it will take more time to make it just fine.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/46ae1b629f4cbff8a4df286e7d2d9aa7f16fe89d.jpg


 Enemy’s reaction to the raised alarm. 

Last bigger challenge, which we’re testing, is the enemy’s reaction in different situations during the battle or crawling. We’re tuning the battle to be amusing but also challenging for the player.

Lastly, we save the best thing for the end. As we mentioned earlier, we’re planning on testing the newest version with the help of a new Steam tool. It’ll be a new experience not for us, but also for our players. This testing will of course need feedback from the players which will be rewarded with a full version of our game for free. All the details will be published on our Discord server.

notes.title: Dev Update - New mission coming soon & 30% OFF
notes.notes:
Greetings our fellow Rebels and followers,

We've been working hard on some new stuff and we're excited to share it with you. So let's dive right into it, shall we?


Bad news - a lot of time wasted
Most of you might not have been aware of it, but in the last 7 months we've put a lot of time, energy and effort negotiating with various investors / publishers about financing our first game. We've attended many events and discussions that costed us a big chunk of time we could have put elsewhere - into the development of course. Due to this matter, a lot of content we've wanted to release this year was either delayed or cut out completely. Unfortunately, we haven't signed contract with any of the related parties as their terms & conditions were unfair and unfavorable.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/e57dd3685464732a298ab3a6d41b9e80b92e10d4.gif

Good news - development status
However, we have good news for you as well. We dedicated whole December into the production - meaning we've been working on last two missions of the first Gray Zone chapter.

We take all your valuable feedback to the heart and we are doing our best to implement accordingly. Our pace is slow, nonetheless, as our team currently consists of only 3 full-time members and one part-time externist. So it's quite difficult.

On the flip side, we obtain resources for the development from outsourcing projects and contracts. This provides us with complete independence, although, we can't afford to enlarge our development teams from such profits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/d7fc2e127cdb9720e4073ffe5d8af9a31c65429f.gif

Tutorial mission
Bringing a tutorial / prologue mission is still part of the plan. As a matter of fact, we've already designed some core gameplay. A goal of the tutorial mission is to guide player through the game's mechanics which will allow the player to adapt and master them on a deeper level.

Achievements Implementation
After-mission statistics are part of a bigger plan and it directly connects to achievements. Some basic ones have already been added. Do you have ideas for some cool achievements? Let us know.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/3532c2c015bdacef26a3075ee1c369bf836343c3.png

Finish line
In any case, we will definitely finish Chapter 1 in our section and we will be looking for alternatives that will allow us further continuation on the project. Don't forget to give us feedback on Discord or Steam so we can constantly improve the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/7232b22df01ecddd8baebab65ca0f996c0090820.gif

30% sale until January 5th
As part of the Steam Winter Sale, Gray Zone is on sale which will last until January 5th 2021.

notes.title: Change of plans: Release update, G.Round program & 30% discount
notes.notes:
Dear rebels,

We, the Gray Zone Team, as well as you - our brave protectors of freedom and peace, have fought hard battles. And for the right cause, no doubt. After all, we are in this together, aren't we?

With this short [not really] announcement, we'd like to inform you about some important changes concerning the date of a full release.

What has changed
Brand new tutorial mission: Play as The Union!
We've decided to create a completely new 'Tutorial/Intro' mission where you play as our antagonist - wait for it - The Union. What we are talking about is a 'bigger' mission where the most basic and advanced mechanics of the game will be explained in detail.
Why tutorial mission?
Entire available feedback and player experience that we have at our disposal has been considered. Clearly, most players are not aware of all the capabilities that the Gray Zone offers. There are situations, where the player knows about a certain feature but doesn't know how to properly utilize it, which is a problem. In another scenario the player is not aware of the feature at all which is even worse.

The Gray Zone offers quite complex system and AI. The 'Tutorial' mission will allow us to properly introduce and explain everything necessary. This will also allow us to remove the tiny bits of tutorial from the story mode, which will increase the dynamics of the game flow.

Of course, Covid situation and scarce resources impact the development process and the release date delay as well. We've been negotiating with investors for the last few months and it is on the right track.

Czech & Slovak Games Week: 30% discount [Oct 36 - Nov 02]
As taking part in the Czech & Slovak Games Week event, we've put a 30% discount on the early access version of Gray Zone. Don't hesitate and check the full list of awesome games made by our fellow brothers & sisters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/2db36c51a6e66d716db6cb032d182d964c7c1c8f.jpg

G.Round program
Gray Zone has recently joined the G.Round program. It is a game testing platform driven by the community. You can register on the platform for free and get access to the exclusive extended demo version of Gray Zone which also includes the first skirmish mission in a style of a sandbox.

notes.title: Rab under attack! Update 1.4: Hire mercenaries, trade loot and more!
notes.notes:
Rebels, unite!

Your sanctuary, the Rab, is under attack. Do you have what it takes to defend it from waves of enemy forces?

Thank you!
First of all, we'd like to thank anyone who have tried our demo in the last couple of weeks. With the new update, the demo has been also updated and a new shop is now available in the first story mission. You can find it in the camp where Breg takes you.

Skirmish #2
Task in hand, commander. Your job in this situation is crystal clear. Defend the Rab at all cost and protect its civilians. Six heavy machine guns are at your disposal. Hire additional soldiers in the heart of Rab if you need to. You can also exchange your credits for ammunition, medical equipment and even weapons!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/80597a7b74068176603295090c11d705fe809ac3.jpg

An enemy attack may come from any direction. Each subsequent wave is stronger than the previous one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/7536acbcf0fc448defc1c40264d05958434ddf2c.gif

City gates - there is a control terminal for each gate, interact with it to open / close the gate, you may want to scavenge bodies for additional ammunition and supplies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/b7a5114c3ed17d3d5dffb9f9b09f0923dcd8004b.gif

New features:

 Inventory - you can now trade items in a shop and move items between your units and a quick inventory, be aware that any unit can carry a maximum of 2 weapons at once
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/352d26771eb56aebbd5c6836c1c81d164d098bdb.png
- press the 'I' key or use a button located in the bottom-left corner of the GUI in order to open / close the Inventory
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/5c08b1b42513e3b39d3b9cb095029b3aff044d1c.gif
 Trading - pick the required amount of an item by left (increase) / right (decrease) clicking and then drag the selected amount to a designated area to buy / sell
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/03950b813471949039d4e472278abf86e2e6d258.gif
 Hire mercenaries - when you approach a neutral unit in a new Skirmish level with a popup 'Hire mercenary' a dialog box will open and if you have enough money you can hire him to join your team, you can even equip him with a better weapon if you buy it in a shop
 Shop has been added to the mission 1 in a Rebel camp and to missions 2 & 5 at the Rab city


We need your feedback!
Thousands of players have played the demo. Sadly, there is a very little feedback to work with. We encourage you, backers and the ones who have played the demo to give us your honest opinion and thoughts of the Gray Zone. We have many plans for the further improvement of the game ourselves, but we'd also like to hear your insights. 

Bug Fixes:

 ground attack will now be cancelled by any other command or a STOP command properly

 gate to the Union fort in Mission 2 now properly opens and Tirell joins the player's team if an optional quest is accomplished

Misc:

notes.title: Scalable GUI, enhanced AI behavior & Roadmap Update
notes.notes:
Greetings rebels,

We come with yet another patch, 1.3.2 that comes with new features, AI enhancements, few tweaks and bug fixes.

IMPORTANT: Bear in mind that we are going for a two-weeks holiday and we won't release a new update sooner than in the middle of August 2020. Until then, stay sharp and enjoy summer!

New features:

 Missile launcher / RPG now estimates future positions of the target
 NPCs controlling a weapon in a stand react to disturbance behind their back. they leave the stand, sort out the situation and get back to the weapon, if they survive (until now, units in this situation were desperate and unable to react to enemies behind their back)
 Scalable GUI - you can now set the size of GUI elements to fit your own preference, no matter the resolution you play with
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/d0c58dbf9d196edef77e71ae19bd356025a515bc.gif
 Added + & - buttons to adjust minimap size within the GUI and a button to reset the rotation (added in patch 1.3.1)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/28898c526f9d138ee529c2f1497e48ab6e52e87c.gif


Bug Fixes:

 Additional level lighting fixes
 Hero snaps to the ground when knocked out above ground, such as in hovercraft and doesn't stay hanging in the air
 Resolved a particular situation, in which units were unable to shoot from cover points
 Some other minor bug fixes

Misc:

 Vehicle AI enhanced a bit, feels more consistent, much less likely to get confused by a tricky maneuvers of an opponent
 Minor tweaks in the first skirmish level


Roadmap Update #02
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/c5ec8d59232729de811b4f0f1316cd42ca325353.jpg

Mission 6 sneak peek
In terms of gameplay, mission is finished for the most part but there is still some work on the environment so consider it a work-in-progress.
[previewyoutube=aP0rIr1Uuao;full][/previewyoutube]

Vision system insight - Height map
Our vision system utilizes the height map ( in a form of a 3D plane ) to determine, whether units see each other or not. Most objects generate height map, so try to keep this in mind when moving through a terrain. You can get from point A to point B unnoticed. Beware, though, as it works both ways. Sometimes there is an enemy standing just behind the corner.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36429485/5269177f48eb869697b36b1df708c455b662b30f.gif

notes.title: Persistent inventory, minimap update & bug fixes
notes.notes:
Attention rebels,

We have a couple of news for you.

This is a smaller patch which brings some enhancements to gameplay, GUI and bug fixes.

New features:

 Units controlled by AI will now blindly shoot in direction of suspicious noises
 It is now possible to carry collected items to next missions, but there is a limit to how many medkids & ammunition you can get through (this will change in future updates as we add new features and mechanics to the game)
 Rotation of the minimap is now optional and can be switched in the settings menu
 Minimap now becomes significantly transparent when not inspected with a cursor
 Added + & - buttons to adjust minimap size within the GUI


Bug Fixes:

 level lighting fixes
 enemy units will now disappear when hidden in bushes

Misc:

 voice feedback of characters when issuing commands during important dialogues is now significantly lowered
 level maps visually enhanced and updated


IMPORTANT: there was an unfortunate event with particular game files due to which all missions except the first one may become unavailable even though you've already progressed further in the story. Saved games will still work so you can load into those missions if you have them. Otherwise, you will have to play from the mission 1. We are sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Update 1.2 released
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

Firstly thank you for sharing your feedback on the game, the majority has been very positive which is really nice for us to hear, of course with any Early Access release there’s going to be a little rough with the smooth and we really appreciate you sharing the bug reports and quality of life suggestions and things like that, we’re pleased to announce our first update for Gray Zone will shortly be hitting Steam to update the game to version 1.2, below is a list of what this update addresses:

Please note, after Steam has updated you should see version number 1.2 in the lower right corner of the main menu.

Bug Fixes:

 Windows 7 support added
 Missing Autosaves added
 Misc Visual fixes
 Video format fix (Game data size reduction)


QOL:

 Graphics settings in menu
 Unity loader removed
 Union Scout Vehicles AI upgraded
 Quick Save/Load: F5/F9
 Improvement's to load/save UI function
 Language selection menu on first run


Misc:

 End Mission Statistics upgrade
 Animals/Creatures have more sounds
 Translations updated


If you reported a bug or suggested a QOL improvement and it’s not included above it doesn’t mean your voice wasn’t heard, simply that it may be coming in a later update.

Please keep those bug reports and feedback coming, it helps us a lot!

Thanks,

EastWorks Studio.

notes.title: Release window news and upcoming plans
notes.notes:
We wanted to take the time to post a little update on our progress with the Early Access version of our upcoming game Gray Zone.

Firstly we wanted to say a big thank you to everyone who has followed the game on Steam, posted comments on Steam/YouTube/Social media etc. etc. it means a lot to us and keeps us energized and excited to show you our progress so far!

Obviously as everyone knows the world right now is going through an unprecedented situation that’s incredibly scary, but also creating a lot of changes in the way we live our lives and in particular how we do our work (for those who’re able to continue working remotely). 

One of the results of these changes over the last couple of weeks means that our upcoming Steam Early Access release of Gray Zone is currently being targeted for week commencing April 30th 2020, whilst I understand this will be disappointing to some people, please rest assured we won’t be resting our laurels and will be using the time to sneak in as much time polishing the gameplay and fixing bugs as possible!

We also wanted to provide a little window into what we’re planning for the first couple of weeks of April (or what has already happened behind the scenes):

 
    Teaser trailer focusing on a specific aspect of gameplay (First in a series).
    Localization completed into the announced 9 languages.
    Localization into Chinese (simplified) being worked on as we speak!
    New screenshots (and bonus comic page) to be released shortly.
    Game soundtrack made available on Steam as DLC.
(every purchase of the soundtrack will be used to further fund Gray Zone's development)
    Streamer build sent out to YouTube streamers of the different localized languages.
 

Thank you for your continued support and we look forward to sharing more news and content throughout the coming weeks.

Please, please, please stay safe out there, look after yourselves and your loved ones and try to stay calm and positive as we all look to get through these uncertain days and weeks ahead!
